tables.name: Industrial District Additional Locations
tables.description: Rolled for each additional location of a Industrial district (Very Small 1 … Very Large 5 per district). 1 and 20: roll again, the next location a step down or up in quality.

results.name: Roll Again (a step down in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step down in quality.

results.name: Cooper
results.description: (Basic) Crafts wooden vessels held together with metal hoops, including barrels, buckets, etc.

results.name: Carpenter
results.description: (Basic) Builds with or carves wood, as well as carrying out repairs.

results.name: General Store
results.description: (Basic) Sells basic supplies, groceries, and various odds and ends.

results.name: Smithy
results.description: (Basic) Sells and crafts metal tools and equipment, including very basic weapons and armor.

results.name: Tailor
results.description: (Basic) Makes and sells clothing, including hats and cloaks. Also sells general items made from cloth, such as blankets, and carries out repairs and alterations of cloth goods.

results.name: Thatcher
results.description: (Basic) Builds roofs using layers of dried straw, reeds, rushes, etc.

results.name: Wainwright
results.description: (Basic) Builds carts and wagons.

results.name: Weaver
results.description: (Basic) Weaves raw fabric and baskets.

results.name: Foundry/Smelting
results.description: (Specialty) Ore processing and metal fabrication.

results.name: Miller
results.description: (Specialty) Facilities for milling grain.

results.name: Textile Production
results.description: (Specialty) Larger scale than a single weaver, offering a wider array of materials in larger quantities.

results.name: Shipwright
results.description: (Specialty) Builds and launches boats and/or ships. Only near significant water (Coastal or River); otherwise rerolled.

results.name: House of Leisure
results.description: Provides entertainment and/or relaxation (GM may decide what kind).

results.name: Club
results.description: Provides entertainment via comedic, dramatic or musical performance.

results.name: Tavern
results.description: Provides food and drink.

results.name: Hired Help
results.description: Hired help; its kind is rolled (1d10), then its size.

results.name: Gathering Hall
results.description: (Non-commercial) General, open-use building used for local activities, or where locals may simply socialize.

results.name: Treasury
results.description: (Non-commercial) Used as a centralised place to manage the funds.

results.name: Roll Again (a step up in quality)
results.description: Roll again, but consider the next location to be a step up in quality.
